text_blocks.snippet: The best gifts for an Indian baby shower (Godh Bharai or Seemantham) are practical newborn essentials or thoughtful pampering items for the mother-to-be.
snippet_highlighted_words: practical newborn essentials or thoughtful pampering items for the mother-to-be

list.snippet: Muslin Clothing & Swaddle Sets: Breathable, 100% natural cotton muslin wraps, jablas, and caps are gentle on newborn skin and ideal for the Indian climate.
Hospital Starter Kits: Pre-packed bundles containing mittens, booties, nappies, and receiving blankets save parents time.
Diaper Caddy Organizer: A portable storage caddy with compartments for diapers, wipes, and creams.
Postpartum Care Basket: A comfort kit with a soft nursing-friendly nightwear set, herbal teas, and stretch mark care.
Keepsake & Memory Boxes: Elegant boxes to store the baby’s first ultrasound scan, hospital tags, and milestone notes.
Cultural & Devotional Keepsakes: Soft plush toys or musical items featuring gentle traditional lullabies.
Traditional Potli or Jute Bags: Eco-friendly bags featuring traditional prints paired with Meenakari boxes or bangles.
Auspicious Favors: Miniature Haldi-Kumkum bottles, Pichwai-themed jars, or brass decor items. You can find traditional options at Wedtree or local handicraft stores.

text_blocks.snippet: If you tell me your budget and your relationship to the mother-to-be (close family vs. friend/colleague), I can recommend a more specific gift or price range.
